name: AIRWA setBurnRate() has no owner check
summary: AIRWA.setBurnRate(uint256) lacked an owner check and the burn on transfers to the pair takes that rate of the pair's own balance. The attacker set the rate to 98%, sent a zero-value transfer to the pair to burn its AIRWA, reset the rate and sold into the inflated price for the pair's USDT.
notes: The owner's own setBurnRate(0) and the trading start time after deployment are not resets. Loss is the AIRWA/USDT pair's USDT; its burned AIRWA is valued at nothing (rule 12).
